## Jira Issue to Slack and Sheets Tracker
Receives Jira issue webhooks, formats the data, notifies Slack, logs to Google Sheets, and sends email digests.

**Setup:**
1. Configure Jira webhook to point to this workflow URL
2. Set Slack channel and Google Sheets credentials
3. Configure Gmail for weekly digest notifications
